confirmed_findings: The old article presented structural decompression, adhesion dissection, spinal-space restoration and Bodyall experience beyond the cited evidence.
The 2023 pilot randomized trial was described as confirming decompression despite a nonsignificant group-by-time interaction.
English and Chinese back links pointed to the Korean index and their Open Graph URLs omitted the encyclopedia directory.
resolved: The article now begins with patient selection and differentiates neurologic, joint and vascular causes before care selection.
Myofascial Chuna, conditional SART and Acupotomy have separate roles with same-task reassessment; canal enlargement and direct neural-decompression claims were removed.
Evidence scope, invasive risks, emergency signals, language links, Open Graph URLs, schema and image size reservation were corrected.
